requirement: Review the repository line by line
evidence: Repo audited at start of session: branch arena/ab4e9b05-fl1 from e001e0a; contents were a single 5-byte README.md with no other files. Recorded in COORDINATION.md.

requirement: Verify everything from official, verified, trusted sources
evidence: 15 official sources assessed; 12 loaded successfully, 3 returned HTTP 404 and are marked NOT VERIFIED and never cited as fact.

requirement: Provide links for manual review
evidence: Every row in every table links to its source record, which links to the live URL for manual review.

requirement: Flag irregularities for review
evidence: Cross-source contradictions and 404 sources published with both sides shown and no resolution applied.

requirement: Collect and organise a full list of requirements
evidence: 20 requirements registered and mapped to the pages that satisfy them.

requirement: Analyse the requirements
evidence: Each requirement carries an evidence note and a status; nothing is marked done without a link.

requirement: Make suggestions to improve decision making
evidence: 15 suggestions, each with problem, proposal, evidence, cost, risk, reversibility, options and a recommendation.

requirement: Create a dedicated section so someone can review suggestions and choose a path before any change is implemented
evidence: Suggestions page is decision-oriented: every entry lists numbered options, trade-offs and one recommended path, and no suggestion has been implemented as a change to the analysis.

requirement: A clear list of questions, information and answers needed before a decision can reasonably be made
evidence: 20 questions, each stating why it matters, what we know, what we do not know, what data is missing, whether it blocks progress, and a recommended path.

requirement: Suggestions to discover missing information
evidence: Every question names the specific missing artefact (price feed, snap counts, bye table, historical seasons) and SG05/SG09/SG13 propose how to obtain it.

requirement: Originate own NFL lines
evidence: Method fully specified: fair-value probability with uncertainty band, input registry, and a pre-kickoff seal. No numeric line is published because no benchmark price feed exists and no model has been fitted yet; publishing a number now would be an invention.

requirement: Research and develop strategies for generating useful signals
evidence: Signal catalogue defined with the data each signal needs and whether that data exists today. Signals are specified, not fitted.

requirement: Treat it as a leaderboard competition with rewards for top strategies
evidence: Leaderboard defined with a ranking formula, tie-breaks, and non-monetary rewards; all entrants currently show BLANK results because no strategy has cleared the gates.

requirement: Cover single bets, parlays and player prop combos
evidence: Three product types specified separately, with the extra gate each one must clear. Parlays and prop combos are marked blocked on joint data.

requirement: Every strategy must pass validation gates
evidence: Eight numbered gates defined with pass criteria and the artefact each one requires. Current status of every candidate is NOT RUN.

requirement: Determine correlation values
evidence: Method specified for team totals from official scoring; player-prop correlations left blank and flagged because the joint sample does not exist yet.

requirement: Remove luck from the equation; build selectively skill-based strategies
evidence: Three separate luck controls defined: calibration, closing-line value, out-of-sample persistence. All three must hold; they are never averaged into one score.

requirement: Track injuries
evidence: Full official Week 10, 2026 injury report captured: 345 player rows across 28 clubs, with practice status and game status, blanks preserved. Verified line by line against the raw capture.

requirement: Know deficiencies where 2nd/3rd/4th string backups replace starters, on defense and on offense
evidence: Official absence data is complete for the 28 clubs captured. Backup-depth ranking is available only as a DERIVED layer because no league-wide official depth chart exists; one club is fully worked and verified as a demonstration.

requirement: Clean landing page with subpages organised by category, table-based, with analysis, plus an executive summary
evidence: Static dashboard with 11 pages, no build step, every table row linked to a source, and a separate executive summary page.
